title: Clipboard
description: Clipboard sync (capability clipboard). clip-push carries text one way; clip-request asks the peer for its latest text. Text is plain-text only, max 262144 chars (256KB); longer payloads are rejected with BAD_REQUEST. changed_at orders pushes; origin breaks echo loops.

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.2.0. Display-only; older peers omit it.

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

text.description: Plain-text clipboard content (clip-push only). Never logged verbatim.

changed_at.description: Unix seconds when the text was copied at the origin.

origin.description: Which side copied the text; receivers drop echoes of their own origin.
